text: Physics is a fundamental discipline that studies the basic structure, motion laws and interactions of matter, covering the analysis of phenomena ranging from microscopic particles (such as quarks and electrons) to the macroscopic universe (such as galaxies and black holes). This major uses mathematics as a tool to explore the laws of nature through theoretical derivation and experimental verification. At the same time, it intersects with engineering, computer science, biology, etc. to form applied branches (such as quantum computing, medical physics). The curriculum system focuses on the cultivation of logical thinking, mathematical modeling and experimental abilities, with the goal of fostering compound talents who possess the capabilities of basic research or technology transformation.
